'''Dorch Vangur''' was a handsome [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] loyal to [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] in [[44 ABY]], commanding the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Consolidator]] that supported the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Imperial Hand]] [[Tahiri Veila]] during the [[Raid on Hagamoor 3]] and ordered the orbital bombardement that cleaned the place after the mission. During the mission to Hagamoor 3, Vangur spent most of his time flirting with Tahiri, something she liked because it distracted her.
